checks.text: On initial load, the page shows the heading "Coin Flip", a button labelled "Flip", a card showing "Tails", and the text "Streak: 0".
Clicking the button "Flip" changes the card to show either "Heads" or "Tails" and updates the text "Streak: 1".
Clicking "Flip" again, if the result matches the previous result, the text updates to "Streak: 2"; if it differs, the text updates to "Streak: 1".
After achieving a streak of 3, the text "Best: 3" is visible on the page.
Clicking the button "Reset" changes the text "Streak: 0" and "Best: 0" and the card shows "Tails".
The card has a button labelled "Grade". Clicking it when the card shows "Heads" adds the text "Correct" below the card.
The card has a button labelled "Grade". Clicking it when the card shows "Tails" adds the text "Incorrect" below the card.
After clicking "Flip" to get "Heads" and "Streak: 1", reloading the page still shows the card with "Heads" and the text "Streak: 1".
